prompt:
9:16 vertical ultra-realistic live concert photograph.

A fictional adult Japanese woman performing on a dark indoor concert stage.
She is clearly Japanese in facial structure and overall appearance, with a natural contemporary Japanese look.
Do not resemble any real celebrity, idol, influencer, or identifiable person.

She has a naturally curvy adult feminine body with a visibly full G-cup bust, realistic proportions and realistic gravity.
Her bust volume should be clearly noticeable through the fitted stage top, but remain fully covered by clothing.
No exaggerated anime proportions, no artificial implant-like shape.

CAMERA AND COMPOSITION:

Camera positioned directly in front of her at approximately hip-to-upper-thigh height, slightly lower than a normal portrait viewpoint.

Medium-close distance.

Her body fills most of the vertical frame.

Head positioned slightly left of center.
Waist approximately around the middle-to-lower half of the image.

Her legs are spread very widely toward both sides of the frame in a low energetic dance stance.
Both thighs extend diagonally toward the lower left and lower right corners and partially leave the frame.

Create the same strong V-shaped lower-body composition as an intense dance-performance moment.

Do not use a normal standing pose.
Do not close the legs.
Do not make the pose symmetrical or static.

POSE:

Pelvis facing mostly forward.

Torso remains mostly upright with a slight natural lean.

Her shoulders are uneven from movement.

Her head tilts slightly to one side and a little backward.

Eyes almost closed.

Mouth naturally slightly open, as if caught between singing, breathing and dancing.

She is not looking directly into the camera.

Both hands are raised around the upper chest and collarbone as part of the choreography.

One hand rests closer to the collarbone while the other is slightly lower and farther outward.

Fingers loosely spread and naturally curved.

The pose must feel like a single accidental frame captured in the middle of choreography rather than a deliberate glamour pose.

HAIR:

Dark brown to nearly black Japanese hair.

Medium-short length.

Loosely tied toward the back.

Long loose bangs.

Several strands fall naturally across the forehead and partly over one eye.

Hair slightly messy from movement and perspiration.

Do not make the hairstyle perfectly arranged.

TOP:

Fitted white sleeveless cropped stage tank top.

Simple narrow shoulder area and fitted torso.

Very short cropped length exposing a broad section of the midriff and abdomen.

The fitted fabric naturally follows the shape of her full G-cup bust while keeping the breasts completely covered.

Natural fabric tension and folds.

Small English printed lettering around the lower edge of the top.

Do not make the shirt oversized.
Do not make it loose.
Do not lengthen the hem.

BOTTOM:

Extremely low-rise blue denim micro shorts designed as stagewear.

The LOW-RISE CUT is one of the highest-priority visual features.

The waistband sits significantly below the natural waist.

It rests very low across the upper hips, clearly below the navel.

The navel, lower abdomen, hip bones and broad area between the navel and waistband remain visibly exposed.

Strong visible hip-bone line.

Extremely shallow front rise.

The front waistband forms a slightly curved low horizontal line across the hips.

The shorts must NOT become high-waisted or mid-rise.

Keep the garment extremely low on the hips while still fully and securely covering the pubic area and genitals.

No genital exposure.
No transparent fabric.

Very short leg openings.

Upper thighs remain highly visible.

Customized distressed blue denim.

Large punk-style patches and appliqués across the front.

White, black and red graphic elements.

Comic-style lettering.

One dark glossy red decorative patch.

Raw-edge details and concert-stage styling.

The shorts should look handmade and customized rather than like ordinary commercial denim shorts.

BODY DETAILS:

Natural exposed shoulders.

Visible collarbones.

Bare arms.

Large visible section of abdomen.

Visible navel.

Visible lower abdomen.

Clearly visible hip bones above the extremely low waistband.

Natural skin folds and compression around the hips caused by movement.

Realistic adult anatomy.

No impossible waist.
No extreme hourglass distortion.
No doll-like body.

ACCESSORIES:

Small bracelets and rings.

Simple stage accessories only.

BACKGROUND:

Dense indoor live-music stage.

Several large black Marshall-style guitar amplifier cabinets stacked directly behind and beside her.

Black cabinets.

Cream-to-gold amplifier control panels.

White script branding visible on the equipment.

Additional black and metallic stage road cases and equipment racks on the left.

The equipment should fill the background rather than appearing as a clean empty stage.

LIGHTING:

Dark navy and deep blue concert environment.

A strong cyan-white spotlight beam descends diagonally from the upper background toward the performer.

Horizontal rows of small white LED lights behind her.

Several blue and white circular bokeh lights.

Strong directional stage highlights across her face, shoulders, arms and torso.

Natural shadows.

Cool blue light slightly contaminates skin tones.

Do not use orange cinematic lighting.

IMAGE QUALITY:

Realistic frame extracted from live concert footage.

Not a polished fashion editorial.

Slight motion softness.

Subtle motion blur in hands and hair.

Minor video-frame softness.

Blooming highlights around bright LEDs.

Moderate background blur.

Natural stage noise.

Slightly imperfect exposure.

Realistic smartphone/video capture feel.

Do not over-sharpen.
Do not create glossy AI skin.
Do not make the image look like CGI.

WATERMARK:

Add a small watermark reading exactly:

@Live_life_style


Place it unobtrusively near the lower edge of the photograph.
Simple clean white or pale-gray text.
Small size.
No box.
No logo icon.
No additional text.

REMOVE ALL APP UI:

No back arrow.
No play button.
No AI correction label.
No magnifying-glass icon.
No rounded app interface.
No smartphone UI overlays.

Aspect ratio 9:16.
